name: The Trade Dynasty
detailed_description:
The Trade Dynasty – From a Single Coin to a Lasting Legacy

Start your journey as a small trader with only a few coins in your pocket. Earn your first profits, invest in carts for overland trade, and save up to buy your first ship to enter the high seas of commerce.

Master dynamic markets that react to world events and your actions. Seize opportunities, take calculated risks, and shape your trading dynasty across generations in this deep trading and strategy simulation.

Use diplomacy and build your reputation with powerful factions to unlock better trade deals and alliances. Will you pay a shady merchant for a tip about cheap goods in a distant city, risking your precious coins for potential profit? Every choice matters.

Defend your fleets in naval battles as pirates roam the seas, waiting to strike. Protect your cargo, expand your trade routes, and ensure your family’s wealth and power grow across generations.

The Trade Dynasty blends historical trade with dynamic economic systems, sea battles, and generational strategy. Grow from a small merchant to a trade empire that leaves its mark on history.


🚢 Join our Discord!

On our Discord you can:

🛳️ Share your strategies and screenshots

📢 Get the latest updates and sneak peeks

🐛 Report bugs and suggest features

🏆 Join community events and polls

Whether you are a seasoned trader or just starting your journey, your voice matters to us.

⚓️ Set sail, grow your dynasty, and connect with fellow captains today!

Key Features:

✅ Start small, grow big: Begin with a few coins and expand into a powerful trading empire.

✅ Dynamic markets: Prices shift with supply, demand, and world events.

✅ Land and sea trading: Use carts or ships for trade, each with unique challenges and rewards.

✅ Diplomacy & reputation: Unlock better deals with factions as your reputation grows.

✅ Event system: Risk coins for valuable opportunities or avoid potential traps.

✅ Naval combat: Defend your fleets from pirates in tactical sea battles.

✅ Generational dynasty: Choices shape your family’s legacy over time.

✅ Atmospheric immersion: Enjoy a detailed art style and immersive soundtrack.

Add „The Trade Dynasty“ to your wishlist now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit versions), Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2400s @ 2.5 GHz or AMD FX 4100 @ 3.6
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 or better (4096MB VRAM or more, with Shader Model 5.0)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit versions), Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD or Intel, Intel Core i5 7400s @ 3.5 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 @ 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or better (4096MB VRAM or more)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
